verdict.why: Left carries more of the brief's defining features (curled dragon-like eave and gable ornaments, tiered shingled roofs, a stone base, and a spire), while Right is cleaner and more coherent in massing but reads as a generic flat-stepped pagoda with few stave-church cues; Left's roof close-up is messy with stray spikes and chaotic stepping, so the overall lean is only slight.
